speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. To help assess this newborn's increasing yellow discoloration, can you tell me exactly when you first noticed the jaundice and if it has spread to the baby's legs? Also, has the baby been feeding well or seems lethargic?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-week-old female newborn. The patient has been experiencing increasing yellow discoloration of her eyes and skin for 2 days. She was born at 39 weeks' gestation, initially weighed 3066 g and now weighs 3200 g. The patient is exclusively breastfed.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding Jaundice (likely insufficient intake leading to dehydration and reduced stooling). REQUEST TEST: Serum Bilirubin Level. REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal Ultrasound to rule out biliary obstruction.
